text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Let us begin, Top Road-san!
The Class Rep Battleeee!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Eh, what!?
A 'Class Rep Battle'? What in the world is that...?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"The 'Class Rep Battle'!
It's a representative-style battle where class reps clash
their class rep powers to spur each other on
and become true role models for students!"
choice_data_list: Th-There's a massive traffic jam of 'Class Reps' here...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Um, in other words... you mean we should push each other
to greater heights for everyone's sake?
By the way, what specifically should we...?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
To put it simply, a consultation showdown! As committee heads,
let's see who can give the better advice!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: I see, killing two birds with one stone by helping everyone... Understood. In that case, challenge accepted!

Before anyone knew it, the class reps were already set
to host an advice counseling session.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Now, our first contestant, come on, BAKUSHIIIN!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"Please, take a seat.
Feel free to talk about anything, okay?"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
I want to go on an overseas expedition someday.
But I have a really hard time learning foreign languages...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Thinking about the future already? Good on you!
Someone like you is sure to see results!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
How about watching foreign films, for example?
Learning while having fun might make it easier to remember!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
I see, there's a way like that...!
Yeah, I feel like I'm getting motivated now!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, both of you!
I'll give it my best shot!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: I'm so glad I could be of help!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
Let's keep this momentum going!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Um... What should I do when I can't find confidence in myself...?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
There is no need to be anxious!
You are wonderful just the way you are!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
They say confidence comes from self-esteem. First,
trying to praise yourself is a great way to start.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
I really wanna fix my foul mouth, y'know~?
Got any good ideas?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"That attitude of self-reflection is splendid!
As long as you hold onto that sentiment, your choice of words will naturally follow!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I also recommend exposing yourself to lovely phrasing and expressions through various writings.
Why not spend some time in the library for a while?

After finishing all the consultations, we conducted
a survey among the advice-seekers to see whose
advice was better, and—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: "Top Road-san's concrete solutions were very helpful."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: "I was given so much courage by Bakushin O-san's powerful encouragement!"
choice_data_list: Looks like it was a draw, huh.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
As expected of Top Road-san!
I'm in awe of your thoughtful and detailed advice!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
You were the one who was wonderful, Bakushin O-chan,
delivering such powerful, sharp words!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. We might make
a pretty good class rep duo, don't you think!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Right! But leaving it unsettled like this just makes me itch with frustration...!!
choice_data_list: How about we settle this with a training match?
Hmm... maybe a face-off with wire puzzles?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Sounds great! Physical stamina is essential for a class rep!
What do you think, Top Road-san?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Bring it on!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Let's compete in a bunch of different events
and decide the winner by total victories!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Yes! So what should we start with?
Squats? Or pull-ups?
Afterward, Narita Top Road and the others competed in various events. However—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Haa, hah....
Mmh, so it's a draw overall?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: "Looks like this contest will have to carry over to next time... Fufu, I won't lose next time!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
Let us both enhance our Class Rep Powers until that time comes!
Sweating refreshingly, Narita Top Road and the others pledged to race each other again.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume D
text_block_list.text:
There you are, Top Road, Madam President!
The teacher has a favor to ask and wants you to come over!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Is that so? Understood.
Thank you for coming to let me know!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, Bakushin O-chan.
Could we put this match on hold for now?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Yes, please don't worry about it!
Your duties as class rep take priority!

And so, the class rep battle came to a close
for now, remaining unresolved.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I see!
So our dependable Class Rep is naturally smart as well!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it, one of my classmates might have it.
...I'll go borrow it real quick!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Mmmgh...!
This tavern puzzle is pretty tricky!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I have an idea of how to solve it,
but my fingertips just won't move right...
In the end, neither of them could solve the disentanglement puzzle, so Round 2 also ended in a draw.
